result.headline: Roll-loop output ch[1] froze at 1500 us at t=118.123 s while roll demand kept varying; pitch tracking degraded near it.
result.explanation: A control fault occurred: actuator.output[ch[1]], which serves the roll loop, stopped following the roll setpoint and held neutral to the end. The data cannot say whether the controller output, the servo path or a failsafe caused it.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[1]] was varying, then held 1500 from t=118.123 s to the end of the recording (10.268 s, 32 samples)
evidence.shows: Freeze of the roll-loop output at neutral, with no event or mode change recorded.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[1]] follows control.attitude_setpoint[roll] (correlation -0.743 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: ch[1] is the roll loop output. Correlation with the roll setpoint was -0.811 before the freeze; after it the output is constant and the correlation is undefined.

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=115.876 s: vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] worse for good (typical |error| 1.076 -> 7.671) (see line 73; strength 3.148)
evidence.shows: Pitch tracking error rose about 11x (1.626 to 18.147 deg) in the window around the freeze. The loop is separate from ch[1], so this may be a second fault or a consequence.

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a12 t=118.123 s: actuator.output[ch[1]] was varying, then held 1500 to the end (see line 25; strength 3.63)
evidence.shows: This is the top-ranked late candidate. compare at 118.123 flags ch[1] as frozen_after: true.

checked.result: ch[1] median 1540 to 1500, spread 11 to 0, flagged frozen. Pitch tracking error ratio 4.2. Roll tracking ratio 1.55.

checked.check: relation roll setpoint vs ch[1], before and after the freeze
checked.result: Correlation -0.811 (lag 0.328 s) before. After the freeze the output is constant, so correlation is null.
checked.about: ch[1] stopped following the roll demand

checked.result: ch[3..5], velocity[y] and the setpoints moved from about 110 s. Attitude[pitch] left baseline at 118.978 s, after the freeze. No events.
checked.about: Pitch degradation as cause or effect

checked.result: Pitch tracking ratio 11.16. The 6 s window runs past the later ch[1] freeze, so the onset is not separable from it.
The roll and yaw setpoints jumped (44.68 deg and 89 deg after). Tracking held. Manoeuvre, not a fault.
Only two events, both at t=0.253 s (start-up). No earlier cases.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=115.876 s: vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] worse for good (typical |error| 1.076 -> 7.671) (see line 73; strength 3.148)
effects.why: Pitch tracking degraded around the freeze. It may be a consequence or a separate fault; the recording cannot separate them.

hypotheses.claim: The controller or mixer held the roll channel at neutral from the freeze onward.
hypotheses.because: The output froze with no event while its roll demand kept varying. The recording shows the output, not the controller internals.
hypotheses.observed_at: recorded actuator output ch[1] and roll setpoint

hypotheses.claim: A servo, wiring or output-stage fault pinned ch[1] at neutral.
hypotheses.because: The recording cannot separate this from a controller fault; it only holds the commanded output.

hypotheses.claim: An unlogged failsafe or mode change neutralised the roll channel.
hypotheses.because: No event is recorded in the window, but the log has only two start-up events so a failsafe may not be logged.

hypotheses.claim: The pitch loop degraded independently, from about 115.876 s.
hypotheses.because: Pitch error rose 11x, but the compare windows include the freeze and attitude[pitch] left baseline after it.

hypotheses.claim: The low-voltage and sensor-health warnings at t=0.253 s explain the fault.
hypotheses.because: Both are start-up messages, and nothing changed at them. The fault is far later in the recording.
